data.title: 阿米娅 · 博士办公室的深夜熟睡
data.description: 罗德岛深夜的指挥官办公室内，繁重的战术批阅终于告一段落。阿米娅卸下了厚重的指挥外套与戒指，身着柔软的奶油色毛衣，不知不觉在沙发扶手边沉沉睡去。当博士为她轻轻盖上毯子时，娇小的兔耳微微晃动，在熟睡中伸出双手握住了熟悉的手指。
data.action: sleeping on sofa, holding doctor's hand, rabbit ears twitching, peaceful face
data.lighting: warm amber desk lamp and terminal screen glow
data.promptProse: Asleep peacefully on the soft leather sofa of the command cabin late at night, Amiya rests without her heavy coat or rings. Wearing a gentle cream knit sweater, her long brown rabbit ears relax softly as she clutches the Doctor's fingers in her sleep.
data.animaCaption: Amiya sleeping peacefully on the sofa holding the Doctor's hand at night.
